title: Breakout radar
description: Technical scan of all 260 stocks for bullish breakout setups. Evaluates: consolidation, trend alignment, RSI, volume pattern, distance from 52-week high.
catalystsDescription: For the top 30 by technical score, Wikipedia attention, Google Trends spikes, Yahoo news from the last week and Finnhub insider/analyst data are additionally loaded. Maximum +25 bonus points. First run takes considerably longer (60-90 s), cached afterwards (6 h).
top5Heading: Fundamental check of top 5 breakout candidates
noMatches: No stocks found with score ≥ {minScore}. Try a lower threshold.
scoreNote: Score composition: up to 30 points proximity to 52-week high · up to 25 points consolidation (Bollinger squeeze) · up to 20 points trend alignment (price > 50d > 200d) · up to 15 points healthy RSI (50-65) · up to 10 points volume dry-up. Not a buy signal — statistical candidate, check chart yourself.
